items.title: Spider Watering a Seedling
items.alt: Brown spider waters a potted seedling with a small green watering can, with eight distinct legs around its body.
items.description: Brown spider waters a potted seedling with a small green watering can, with eight distinct legs around its body. Useful for gardening stories and plant-care activities.

items.title: Spider beside a Seed Basket
items.alt: Gray spider with eight legs leans over a woven basket containing three sunflower seeds.
items.description: Gray spider with eight legs leans over a woven basket containing three sunflower seeds. Useful for seed sorting stories and classroom nature activities.

items.title: Spider above a Blank Banner
items.alt: One spider spreads eight legs above a broad blank cream banner with gently curled ends and room for personal wording.
items.description: One spider spreads eight legs above a broad blank cream banner with gently curled ends and room for personal wording. Useful for personal labels.
